summary: PASS. Caveat: no shell tool was available, so I could not run `git diff`. I reviewed the current worktree files directly (HtmlRenderer.tsx, htmlInlineStyles.ts, HtmlRenderer.test.tsx, smartviewer-html-render.spec.ts) and grepped SmartViewer.tsx, so the merged-vs-follow-up split is inferred, not diffed. Merged behaviour: relative stylesheet links are fetched through fetchFileText and inlined as <style>, with a </style escape. Absolute, protocol-relative and fragment hrefs are left alone. A failed fetch leaves the original link in place. The iframe is held until inlining finishes (`ready` check on source and path). The sandbox attribute (no allow-same-origin) and the CSP string (connect-src 'none', form-action 'none') are intact. SmartViewer.tsx line 245 passes projectId, path and onPopOut to HtmlRenderer, and the pop-out opens SmartViewerModal. The button renders only when onPopOut is given, so the modal-nested instance has none, same as markdown. Follow-up coverage: unit tests cover hold-until-inlined (loads once), fetch-reject fallback to the raw link, and no reuse of an inlined result after a path change. The E2E spec checks the stylesheet colour inline and in the modal, and that the modal has no nested pop-out. The header comment is re-wrapped. Nothing is missing and I found no scope creep.
